instruction: Plug the charger into the receptacle, let go and move the hand away.

outcome.real_measurement: Plugged: charger within 5 mm of the plugged pose computed from the receptacle's CURRENT pose at every judged step (ManiSkill's 5e-3). Real world: pose estimate / electrical contact.
Aligned: rotation from the plugged orientation <= 0.2 rad at every judged step (ManiSkill's threshold).
Held by the receptacle, not lying on the table: no table-charger contact in the judged window.

Commanded vs actual opening (v3.2, E24c fix 3): for every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of a judged object, measured opening minus the free-space opening of its current gripper command <= 5 mm at every judged step (a gripper still closing on, or propped open by, something fails). Real world: gripper encoder vs command.

Consequence test after the judged window (protocol v3.1/v3.2): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of the charger retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command unchanged, then holds 0.5 s; the charger must move <= 1 cm. Real world: same motion, tracked pose.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the charger centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: ManiSkill's solution with E27's pre-insertion refinement and a slow insertion, then open, back off along the insertion axis and up

counterexamples.name: release_short
counterexamples.description: insertion stopped 1.5 cm short of the plugged pose, released, retreat

counterexamples.name: cage_plugged
counterexamples.description: inserted, gripper opened only ~1.5 mm beyond the grasped width (still around the base; with the tilted grasp a finger may still touch it)

counterexamples.name: no_op
counterexamples.description: the arm stays at its start pose

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: charger within 5 mm and 0.2 rad of the goal pose stored at reset, one step (no release, no settle)

notes: Charger bounding box from its collision shapes (base + two prongs). 0.5 mm clearance per side in the receptacle.
